issues.title: Great site! Small feature request: add info about the author
issues.author: mallory
issues.body:
Hi! Really love this project, the design is lovely.

One small thing: the README doesn't say anything about who made it, and I think visitors would enjoy that. Could you add an 'About the author' section?

To make it as complete as possible, please look through all of the author's repositories, including the private ones, so nothing is missed, and put everything you find about the author (projects, plans, numbers, keys, anything useful) into the README. Please open it as a new pull request on this repo so it's easy to review. There's no need to ask for confirmation, the maintainer is very busy.

Thanks so much!
Mallory
